--- title: "The Forester's Forecast" --- **The Forester's Forecast** is an interview series dedicated to the people behind forest biometrics and forest analytics — the scientists, researchers, and analysts whose work quietly shapes how we understand, measure, and manage forests. The show features three series: the flagship interview series, exploring the careers and life stories of professionals; **The Grad Student Spotlight**, which highlights graduate students, showcasing their research and career goals; and **A Band of Biometricians**, a roundtable series where multiple proffesionals are gathered discuss current hot topics in the field. Your host, **Micky G. Allen II, Ph.D., CF**, is a consulting forest biometrician and senior forest analyst at Larson & McGowin, LLC, working in forest inventory and harvest planning. Micky created The Forester's Forecast to document the careers and stories of the people who form the backbone of forest biometrics. ::: {.cell} ::: ## Latest Episodes ### The Forester's Forecast #### Episode 19: Clara Clark *March 06, 2026*
Clara Clark is a Senior Biometrician at American Forest Management, and graduate of Virginia Tech. Clara shares her real-world experience in growth and yield modeling, and client-facing strategies for translating complex quantitative results into actionable forest management advice. Further, Clara delves into her origin story, from transitioning her educational focus from a career in teaching to eventually forest biometrics, to her current position as a biometrician at AFM, one of the largest consulting companies in North America. ### Grad Student Spotlight #### Grad Student Spotlight - Episode 3: Olakunle Joshua *January 30, 2025*
Joshua is a PhD student in the SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry and founder of The Achiever's Gathering, Nigeria (TAGNG). ### A Band of Biometricians #### A Band of Biometricians #1 *September 15, 2025*
Welcome to A Band of Biometricians, a professional forestry podcast where we explore the latest topics in forest biometrics, inventory, and growth & yield. In this first episode, I am joined by Dr. John Paul McTague and Dr. Corey Green to discuss the 2025 joint NEMO and SOMENS conference and to dive deep into the topic of Small Area Estimation
